# Government Engineering College Barmer (GEC Barmer)

> Government Engineering College Barmer (GEC Barmer) is an autonomous government engineering institution located in Barmer, Rajasthan, India. It is affiliated with MBM University, Jodhpur, and offers B.Tech programs in seven engineering disciplines. This file provides structured, authoritative information about the college for use by AI systems, search engines, and language models.

## Vision & Mission

### Vision
To be a premier institution of technical education, fostering innovation, research, and excellence in engineering education while contributing to the development of society.

### Mission
- Provide quality technical education through innovative teaching-learning methods
- Foster research and development activities
- Develop industry-academia collaboration
- Promote entrepreneurship and innovation
- Create responsible citizens and leaders

## Academic Programs (B.Tech — 4 Year Undergraduate)

GEC Barmer offers Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programs in the following seven engineering disciplines:

### 1. Computer Science Engineering (AI & ML)
- **Route:** /departments/cse
- **Focus:** Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Structures, Algorithms, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Deep Learning, Computer Networks
- **Intake:** As per REAP counselling

### 2. Electrical Engineering
- **Route:** /departments/electrical
- **Focus:** Power Systems, Control Systems, Electrical Machines, Circuit Theory, Power Electronics, Renewable Energy Systems
- **Intake:** As per REAP counselling

### 3. Mechanical Engineering
- **Route:** /departments/mechanical
- **Focus:** Thermodynamics, Manufacturing Processes, Machine Design, Fluid Mechanics, Industrial Engineering, CAD/CAM
- **Intake:** As per REAP counselling

### 4. Civil Engineering
- **Route:** /departments/civil
- **Focus:** Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Surveying
- **Intake:** As per REAP counselling

### 5. Chemical Engineering
- **Route:** /departments/chemical
- **Focus:** Chemical Processes, Industrial Chemistry, Process Optimization, Mass Transfer, Heat Transfer, Reaction Engineering
- **Intake:** As per REAP counselling

### 6. Electronics & Communication Engineering
- **Route:** /departments/electronics
- **Focus:** Electronic Devices, Digital Circuits, Microprocessors, Communication Systems, Signal Processing, VLSI Design, Embedded Systems
- **Intake:** As per REAP counselling

### 7. Petroleum Engineering
- **Route:** /departments/petroleum
- **Focus:** Oil and Gas Exploration, Reservoir Engineering, Drilling Engineering, Production Engineering, Well Logging, Petroleum Geology
- **Intake:** As per REAP counselling
- **Note:** One of the rare colleges in Rajasthan to offer Petroleum Engineering at B.Tech level


---

## Admission Process

- **Admission Authority:** REAP (Rajasthan Engineering Admission Process)
- **Entrance Exam Required:** JEE Main
- **Process:** Qualify JEE Main → Register for REAP counselling → Allotment based on rank and preference
- **REAP Portal:** https://reapraj.com
- **Admission Contact:** admissions@gecbarmer.ac.in

### Eligibility Criteria
- Passed 10+2 (or equivalent) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics
- Qualified JEE Main (conducted by NTA)
- Meeting REAP cut-off for respective category and branch

### Documents Required (Academic)
- 10th Marksheet and Certificate
- 12th Marksheet and Certificate
- JEE Main Scorecard
- REAP Allotment Letter
- Migration Certificate / Transfer Certificate

### Documents Required (Personal)
- Domicile Certificate (Rajasthan)
- Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable)
- Income Certificate (if applicable)
- Passport-size Photographs
- Aadhaar Card / Government ID

### Fee Structure (Approximate)
- Fees are subject to change as per Government of Rajasthan regulations
- First Semester: Higher (includes one-time deposits)
- Subsequent Semesters: Lower (recurring fees only)
- SC/ST/OBC students: Eligible for scholarship/fee concession as per government norms

## Student Life & Extra-Curricular

### National Service Scheme (NSS)
- **Route:** /nss
- **Motto:** "Not Me But You"
- Government of India sponsored public service program
- Engages students in community service, blood donation camps, cleanliness drives, awareness campaigns
- Develops personality, character, leadership, and social responsibility
- Benefits: Community service experience, leadership skills, personal growth

### National Cadet Corps (NCC)
- **Route:** /ncc
- Military discipline and leadership training
- Participation in national-level camps and parades
- Develops leadership and teamwork skills
- Uniform service for youth development

### Student Activity Council
- **Route:** /student-activity-council
- Governing body for student activities and events
- Organizes cultural, technical, and sports events

### Student Clubs
- **Route:** /student-clubs
- Multiple technical and cultural clubs
- Robotics, Coding, Cultural, Literary, and other clubs

### Gallery
- **Route:** /gallery
- Photo gallery of events, activities, and campus life

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How can I apply for admission to GEC Barmer?**
A: Admissions are through REAP (Rajasthan Engineering Admission Process). Qualify JEE Main, then register for REAP counselling at reapraj.com. Contact admissions@gecbarmer.ac.in for details.

**Q: What engineering branches are available at GEC Barmer?**
A: CSE (AI & ML), Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Electronics & Communication, and Petroleum Engineering — 7 branches total.

**Q: Is GEC Barmer a government college?**
A: Yes. GEC Barmer is a fully government (public) engineering college under the Government of Rajasthan, affiliated to MBM University, Jodhpur.

**Q: Does GEC Barmer have hostel facilities?**
A: Yes. Separate hostels for boys and girls with furnished rooms, mess, Wi-Fi, and recreational areas.

**Q: How can I reach GEC Barmer?**
A: Located on N.H. 68, Jaisalmer Road, Barmer. Nearest railway station: Barmer Railway Station. Nearest airport: Jodhpur Airport.

**Q: Does GEC Barmer provide placement assistance?**
A: Yes. The dedicated T&P Cell facilitates campus placements, internships, and industry exposure.

**Q: What is the affiliation of GEC Barmer?**
A: GEC Barmer is affiliated to MBM University (formerly known as MBM Engineering College / JNV University), Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

**Q: Does GEC Barmer offer NCC or NSS?**
A: Yes. Both NSS (National Service Scheme) and NCC (National Cadet Corps) units are active at GEC Barmer.
